name: Moon VR Video Player
summary: Slick Quest & Apple Vision Pro VR media cinema app offering crisp passthrough dimming, AI 2D-to-3D depth, and easy Wi-Fi AirPlay streaming.
ranking_rationale: Native Apple Vision Pro & Meta Quest 3 spatial UI with clean passthrough edge; weighed against lacks built-in slr/deovr funscript hardware haptic automation.

pricing.notes: Pricing and promos change frequently; verify directly at official checkout.

pros: Native Apple Vision Pro & Meta Quest 3 spatial UI with clean passthrough edge
Smooth wireless PC/NAS AirPlay streaming without copying giant 20GB MP4s
cons: Lacks built-in SLR/DeoVR funscript hardware haptic automation
